summary: Examples of b64encode on literals and variables, with utf-16-le encoding, and URL-safe encoding.
questions: How do I Base64 encode text as UTF-16LE for PowerShell?
What does a b64encode example look like?

answer_card.title: b64encode examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
b64lola: "{{ 'lola' | b64encode }}"
b64stuff: "{{ stuff | b64encode }}"
b64stuff: "{{ 'Ansible - くらとみ\n' | b64encode(encoding='utf-16-le') }}"
b64stuff: "{{ 'https://www.python.org/example-1' | b64encode(urlsafe=True) }}"
```
